description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigAPI class which handles REST API requests for database configuration during an installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for processing POST requests to set and verify database details and GET requests to retrieve current database configuration.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing database configuration settings during system installation or upgrade, with methods to handle GET and POST requests for database details.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save database configuration details and validate the database connection.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve current database configuration details.
